HOW WE WORK

From request to handover
without guesswork.

The client journey for on-site support, dispatch and project work. Commercial commitments appear only in your written quote or agreement.

Plan your projectExplore services

CLIENT JOURNEY

The usual sequence.

01

Request

You send an enquiry with location, timing, scope and access context.

02

Scope

We clarify skills, exclusions, dependencies and any partner branding rules.

03

Written quote

You receive commercial terms for the defined work—not a verbal blanket promise.

04

Schedule

Once accepted, attendance or delivery windows are booked with named contacts.

05

Deliver

Work follows the approved scope; changes are raised before extra effort proceeds.

06

Handover

You receive evidence, open items and sign-off appropriate to the task.

QUOTE INPUTS

What we need from you.

✓Site location and access requirements
✓Preferred dates or windows
✓Task scope, skills and success criteria
✓Equipment, parts and escalation owner

SITE ACCESS AND CHANGES

Keeping work controlled.

Site contacts, permits, parking, induction and chaperone rules must be stated before attendance. Engineers follow the authorised work order. If on-site conditions differ, the change is documented and escalated rather than improvising production changes.

Who signs off: the named customer or partner approver identified in the work order. What you receive: visit or project evidence agreed in advance (for example time on site, tasks completed, test results, asset notes and outstanding issues).
